statutoryBasis: Ministry of Health (MOH) Singapore Standard Drug List (SDL) & Medication Assistance Fund (MAF) Framework; Agency for Care Effectiveness (ACE) Methods Guidance; Goods and Services Tax Act (GST 9%)
provenance: MOH Singapore Drug Advisory Committee (DAC); Agency for Care Effectiveness (ACE); Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore (IRAS)

taxRates.description: Standard Singapore GST rate (9%) applicable to pharmaceutical sales, wholesale distribution, and unsubsidised pharmacy charges

healthcareClusters.name: Singapore Health Services (SGH, KKH, SKH, CGH, NCCS, NHCS, SNEC, SingHealth Polyclinics)
National Healthcare Group (TTSH, KTPH, WHC, IMH, NSC, NHG Polyclinics)
National University Health System (NUH, NTFGH, AH, NUP Polyclinics)

SDL.name: Standard Drug List
SDL.description: Primary essential drug formulary listing approved by MOH DAC based on cost-effectiveness assessment by ACE

MAF.name: Medication Assistance Fund
MAF.description: Targeted financial assistance scheme for high-cost, specialised therapeutics for specific clinical indications recommended by ACE

NON_SUBSIDISED.name: Non-Subsidised / Private Formulary
NON_SUBSIDISED.description: Self-funded therapeutics not listed on SDL or MAF; full retail price plus handling markup and GST borne by patient or private insurance
